# The Glownique

> Handcrafted custom LED neon signs, 3D metal channel letters, ultra-thin lightboxes and acrylic logo signs. Free 1-on-1 design mockups.

The Glownique specializes in premium, bespoke illuminated signage for B2B buyers (boutique business owners, corporate HQs, salon owners, restaurants, interior designers) and high-value B2C buyers (weddings, home decor, gaming rooms).

## Key Products
- **Custom LED Neon Signs**: Commercial-grade 12V silicone LED neon signs mounted on cast acrylic. Perfect for homes, weddings, and aesthetic storefronts.
- **3D Metal Channel Letters**: Precision-fabricated 304 stainless steel signs available in front-lit, halo back-lit, and dual-lit configurations. Designed for corporate branding.
- **Ultra-Thin Lightboxes**: Edge-lit slim aluminium lightboxes featuring tool-free graphic swaps for retail menus and displays.
- **UV Print Acrylic Signs**: High-definition UV printing combined with glowing LED neon contours.

## Service Guarantees
- Free true-to-scale mockup and quote within ~2 hours.
- 5-year studio warranty on commercial builds.
- 5,000+ happy clients.
- Global, tracked, insured shipping (shipped in secure timber crates).
